newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER'S MOLDOVAN MIGHT JOIN COLOGNE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER'S MOLDOVAN MIGHT JOIN COLOGNE.

text.p: German first division side Cologne reportedly want to sign Romanian striker Viorel Moldovan from Swiss champions Grasshopper Zurich.
Moldovan, who was the Swiss first division's leading scorer last season, would join a Romanian contingent at Cologne which already includes striker Ion Vladoiu and midfielder Dorinel Munteanu.
Cologne would have to pay a transfer fee of around four million marks ($2.4 million) for the 24-year-old player, who has a contract with Grasshopper until 1999.
